premises.text: Home cancer patients lack monitoring of blood counts and vitals, so infections cause hospitalizations and delayed chemo
premises.evidence_span: there was no way to keep track of changes in his blood cell counts and his vitals

premises.text: An implanted smart chemo port with microelectronics and optical sensors measures blood cells, heart function, and vitals in the body
premises.evidence_span: implanted smart port that detects early signs of infection by measuring changes in blood cell counts, heart function, and vitals

premises.text: Machine learning on longitudinal port data alerts physicians to health-status changes before symptoms via EMR-integrated API
premises.evidence_span: our software uses machine learning to look for changes in health status before symptoms emerge

premises.text: The port gathers monitoring data with no additional burden on patients versus wearables or clinic labs
premises.evidence_span: NextGenPort gathers a data package that has no additional burden on the patients

premises.text: Go-to-market sells the technology to port manufacturers
premises.evidence_span: GoToMarket focuses on selling the technology to port manufacturers

premises.text: FDA 510K and verified CPT reimbursement codes provide a commercialization path
